description: Search every FHA-insured apartment loan in HUD's active multifamily file by state, city, program, note rate, years left, servicer or text. Returns HUD's figures (note rate, original amount, amortized balance, maturity, holder, servicer, Section of the Act) with a property page URL. Use it to find assumable low-rate loans, loans by a servicer, or a property's FHA number.

max_rate.description: Maximum note rate, percent (e.g. 4 for assumable low-rate loans).

q.description: Words to match in property name, city, address, ZIP or FHA number.

name: search_loans
title: Search FHA-insured apartment loans
